bandit_hideout.name: Bandit Hideout
bandit_hideout.description: A secret refuge hidden in the woods, where thieves and scoundrels hoard food stolen from travelers under the guidance of dangerous goblins.

abandoned_keep.name: Abandoned Keep
abandoned_keep.description: An ancient military stronghold now in ruins, occupied by ruthless orcs who still guard the equipment of old soldiers.

blackstone_catacombs.name: Blackstone Catacombs
blackstone_catacombs.description: A grim underground labyrinth full of ransacked tombs. Reanimated skeletons wander among forgotten potions and dusty gold coins.
